first_tick_commands: execute if entity @s[advancements={lanterncorps:bluelantern=false}] run advancement grant @s only lanterncorps:bluelantern

bluelantern.title: Hope Ring Bearer
bluelantern.description: With this ring you have been Chosen to become a Blue Lantern.

constructcreation.title: Construct Creation
constructcreation.description: Concentrate and Create different Items with your Ring.

hopeshield.title: Hope Shield
hopeshield.description: You must have a empty Offhand to use this ability.
first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with final_lanterns:blueshield{CustomTag:blue}

inflicthope.title: Inflict Hope
inflicthope.description: Inflict hope to entities around you giving some energy regen and others debuff

ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your hope. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Hope Max lvl 3

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:bluelanternconstruction
